facts.statement: In a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease, removing the gene for myeloperoxidase led to better memory and less amyloid buildup.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Researchers created a drug called LERAMI that is wrapped in liposomes and only activates when it encounters high levels of reactive oxygen species.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The drug uses a chemical link that breaks only in areas with high oxidative stress, which helps avoid side effects in the rest of the body.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Treating the mice with LERAMI improved their cognitive abilities and reduced brain inflammation, DNA damage, and amyloid levels.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Gene expression analysis showed that the treatment increased activity in brain regions related to learning and memory while decreasing inflammatory signals.
facts.subject: animals
